name: @metaharness/agntcy
description: AGNTCY (Cisco Outshift / Linux Foundation Internet of Cognition) build-time integration for generated MetaHarness agents: AGNTCY identity (W3C DID + verifiable-credential badges signed into the ADR-011 witness manifest), OASF capability-record export and AGNTCY Directory publishing, AGNTCY semantic observability (OpenTelemetry semantic-convention attributes for agent/coordination/authorization/model-route/memory-provenance/evaluation spans), and the CASA intent-to-authority-envelope compiler (deterministic free-text-objective -> bounded allow/deny/budget/expiry schema, enforcement owned by the runtime, never by this package). Optional peer package per ADR-002 kernel-boundary discipline and ADR-237 SS5 -- never a hard kernel dependency. No public AGNTCY npm packages exist yet under any guessed name (verified); Directory-publish and identity-provider calls are config-gated stubs pending upstream availability. Dependency-free (Node built-ins).
author: rUv <ruv@ruv.net>
